title: PAN
section: Application for allotment of New PAN (Form No. 93 / Form No. 94) – applicable for Citizens of India
text:
### Application for allotment of New PAN (Form No. 93 / Form No. 94) – applicable for Citizens of India
This form should be used when the applicant has never applied for a PAN or does not have PAN allotted to him. An applicant can visit Income Tax Department (ITD) website to find whether a PAN has been allotted to him or not.
  * [Read Guidelines](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/form-form_93-form_94.html)
  * [Read Instructions](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html)
  * [Documents to be Submitted](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/documents-form_93-form_94.html)
  * [Do’s and Don’ts](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/new-do-donts.html)
  * [Apply](https://onlineservices.proteantech.in/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html)
  * [Designated centres accepting Online PAN documents New](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/%20downloads/List_Of_Centres_For_Submission_Of_Online_PAN_Documents.xlsx)
